name: Bouquet of Convex Geometries
statement: A finite family $\mathcal C\subseteq2^E$ contains $\varnothing$, is closed under intersections, and is locally extendable: whenever $Y,X\in\mathcal C$ with $Y\subsetneq X$, some $e\in X\setminus Y$ satisfies $Y\cup\{e\}\in\mathcal C$.
comments: Bouquet of convex geometries is the terminology used by Chalopin--Chepoi--Knauer for the class introduced earlier as conditional antimatroids.
